solutionSql:
SELECT c.id,
       c.name
FROM customers c
JOIN (
  SELECT customer_id,
         AVG(weight_kg) AS avg_w
  FROM shipments
  WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY customer_id
) cs ON cs.customer_id = c.id
WHERE cs.avg_w > (SELECT AVG(weight_kg) FROM shipments)
ORDER BY c.id;

ambiguities.phrase: Return id and name for each customer whose average shipment weight is greater than the average weight of all shipments.
ambiguities.readingChosen: The table average is the mean of every recorded shipment weight, so each shipment counts equally.
ambiguities.alternativeReading: The table average is the mean of the per-customer averages, so each customer counts equally.

notes: Missing weights are excluded from both averages, as the ticket says. Customers 7 and 8 have no shipments and so have no average. The three qualifying customers are 2, 4 and 5.
